messages:
ella_oncall: FYI - noticed a cluster-wide bump of 'nvidia: probe deferred' after the 6.5 roll in eu-west2. provisioning backlog and some NCCL handshakes failing on P4s.

mike_infra: ugh. numbers?

ella_oncall: ~18 hosts hit, ~35% of new p4 allocations see driver probe deferred and later evict. dmesg snippet:

    [  8.123456] nvidia: loading out-of-tree module taints kernel
    [  8.123789] nvidia: probe of 0000:3b:00.0 failed with error -517
    [ 12.987654] nvidia: module probe deferred for 0000:3b:00.0

nora_hw: that -517 is -EPROBE_DEFER, usually missing PCI resource or ordering issue vs nvlink. seen similar with 6.x + older nv driver ABI. which driver + cuda version?

ella_oncall: drivers seem to be 525.105 + CUDA 11.8 in the image we pushed. kernel 6.5.0-rc on the canary pool.

devin_sre: also seeing repeated pci link resets in journal: "PCIe bus error: severity=Corrected" then GPUs drop to D3 and drivers rebind. NCCL logs show handshake timeouts between ranks during pod startup.

mike_infra: impact: autoscaler can't place ~20% of queued requests -> provisioning backlog rising; customers on Dedicated seeing longer warmup. cost wise we're burning extra p4 spinups.

ella_oncall: rolling back the canary would stop new hosts from hitting it but doesn't recover already-upgraded hosts. thoughts on fast mitigations?

nora_hw: options: 1) build DKMS module against 6.5 and push new node image, 2) revert kernel on affected hosts, 3) temporary firmware/pci quirk via kernel cmdline to avoid link retrain. DKMS is safest long term but takes time.

mike_infra: can we hotfix by forcing the nvidia module to use deferred probe workaround? e.g., modprobe with options?

devin_sre: modprobe cannot fix probe ordering if core kernel subsystems aren't ready. tried insmod with ignore-limits earlier, no dice.

ella_oncall: deploy-bot: annotate incident and pause further 6.5 rollouts.

deploy-bot: @ella_oncall noted. New kernel rollouts paused for eu-west* pools.

mike_infra: action plan proposal:
- Pause rollouts (done)
- Immediately mark canary pool read-only and prevent new allocations
- Drain 10 most-affected hosts and reprovision with pinned kernel 6.4 image
- Begin DKMS build for 525.xx against 6.5 on a test pool and smoke test NCCL/PCI stability
- If DKMS works, schedule node image rebuild and gradual replace; else rollback host kernel across the fleet

nora_hw: agree. Also add nvlink/pci reset guard in kubelet to reduce flapping while we replace nodes.

devin_sre: I'm starting the DKMS build on a spare host now. log:

    $ git checkout release/525
    $ dkms add -m nvidia -v 525.105
    $ dkms build -m nvidia -v 525.105 -k 6.5.0-rc
    $ dkms install -m nvidia -v 525.105 -k 6.5.0-rc

ella_oncall: keep it tight. if DKMS passes smoke (3-hour run, multiple container startups, nvtop/eviction check), we can push a new image. else we roll kernel back cluster-wide for affected pools.

mike_infra: also alerting infra-cost: if we have to reprovision 100 hosts, that’s ~3 days of extra spot usage + support churn. flag finance.

ella_oncall: @ops-bot can you create a billing watch and escalate cost to finance?

ops-bot: Billing watch created, threshold $15k/day. Finance alerted.

nora_hw: one more datapoint: older driver builds sometimes hit a symbol mismatch with 6.5's scheduler callbacks. if DKMS build fails with unresolved symbols, we'll need a driver bump (526+) or to pin kernel.

devin_sre: DKMS build finished on test host: build succeeded, module inserted, initial smoke looks good. running a GPU heavy NCCL test now.

mike_infra: good. timeline to image rollout?

devin_sre: can get a new image with DKMS module in ~6 hours, need approvals for canary replacement.

ella_oncall: rough rollback plan if DKMS fails mid-rollout: schedule maintenance window, cordon+drain, boot into 6.4 image, bring back into pool with limited capacity. communicate to customers 2h ETA.

nora_hw: please capture dmesg+pci dumps for the 18 affected hosts before reprovisioning. may help final root cause.

ella_oncall: will do. pulling logs -> /var/log/gpu-probe-defer/1978524680/ (will drop to S3).

mike_infra: FYI - starting the drain of 5 worst hosts now, will reattach if DKMS validated.

devin_sre: NCCL test passed on DKMS image (1000-rank small-scale simulation). moving to cluster-level canary (5 hosts).

ella_oncall: thanks all. status: rollouts paused, DKMS image building -> canary replacement if green. will update thread when canary completes. :white_check_mark:

mike_infra: tagging incident for postmortem once stabilized. include cost delta and rollout automation gap.

ella_oncall: noted. closing loop -> next update in 2h or earlier on failure.
